The maximum volume limit in VLC has been successfully increased from 125% to 200%. This was accomplished by:

1. Opening VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences)
2. Switching to Advanced settings (All radio button)
3. Navigating to Interface > Main interfaces > Qt
4. Finding the "Maximum Volume displayed" setting
5. Changing the value from 125 to 200
6. Saving the changes

You can now enjoy movies with up to 200% volume in VLC, which should provide significantly louder audio than the previous 125% maximum limit.
